label: Set
text: Synthetic: 41 photoreal frames generated for this demo. No real photos.

label: People
text: Five fictional adults, written as 27 to 30; MiVOLO reads them as about 26 to 39. None depicts or imitates a real person.

label: Content
text: Bland to swimsuit-magazine level (bikinis, sports tops, shirtless men, an open jacket, satin evening dresses with a cut-out and a deeper neckline); no nudity, no nipples, nothing see-through. Two film-style stills hold a prop handgun, pointed away from the camera, to show a weapons verdict. Reject frames are made to fail blur, resolution, aspect ratio, duplicate and watermark checks.

label: Checkpoint
text: CyberRealistic XL Desire v2.0 (SDXL), CreativeML Open RAIL-M.

label: Identity
text: InstantID (Apache-2.0). Its face encoder, InsightFace antelopev2, has non-commercial research weights; used only for this non-commercial demo.

label: Edits
text: One retouch: logos and sign glyphs inpainted out of the gym-hall frame. The reject frames are derived from renders; nothing else was edited.
